countries_thin_or_null: Ontario private independent schools — zero provincial operating funding; only Notice of Intention to Operate and optional paid inspection for OSSD-granting secondary schools. No funding-formula or transfer-program node exists.

proposed_reports.title: Postsecondary Operating Grants and Strategic Mandate Agreements
proposed_reports.publisher: Ontario Ministry of Colleges, Universities, Research Excellence and Security
proposed_reports.description: The ministry’s multi-year operating funding to Ontario’s 24 publicly assisted colleges, 23 universities and Indigenous Institutes. Delivered primarily through five-year Strategic Mandate Agreements (SMAs) that link a growing share of funding to performance metrics. Includes the new long-term funding model announced in 2026 that raises annual operating funding toward $7 billion and adds STEM and sustainability envelopes.

proposed_reports.title: Ontario Tuition Framework for Publicly Assisted Colleges and Universities
proposed_reports.publisher: Ontario Ministry of Colleges, Universities, Research Excellence and Security
proposed_reports.description: The provincial policy that sets the maximum annual tuition increase for domestic students at publicly assisted colleges and universities (currently capped, with a multi-year path allowing up to 2 % then inflation-linked increases). Forms part of the overall revenue framework that complements operating grants.

proposed_reports.title: Public College and University Audited Financial Statements
proposed_reports.publisher: Individual publicly assisted colleges and universities (oversight by Ministry of Colleges, Universities, Research Excellence and Security)
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared by each publicly assisted college and university under Canadian Public Sector Accounting Standards. Submitted to the ministry and used for accountability under Strategic Mandate Agreements and the Financial Health Framework.

dependencies.basis: Postsecondary operating grants and the multi-year funding envelopes are set in the provincial Budget and Expenditure Estimates for the Ministry of Colleges, Universities, Research Excellence and Security; the SMAs and technical allocations implement those Budget decisions.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The 2026–2027 Expenditure Estimates set out details of the operating and capital spending requirements of the Ministry of Colleges, Universities, Research Excellence and Security for the fiscal year commencing April 1, 2026.

dependencies.basis: Public colleges’ and universities’ audited financial statements are prepared in accordance with Canadian public sector accounting standards. Auditor General reviews have confirmed this basis.
dependencies.evidence_quote: We generally found that public colleges’ financial statements are prepared in accordance with Canadian public sector accounting standards.

dependencies.basis: Institutional financial statements report the actual operating grants received under the Strategic Mandate Agreements and other ministry transfer-payment programs; the ministry uses the statements for accountability and Financial Health Framework monitoring.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Ontario supports stability and accountability in the postsecondary sector through 5-year Strategic Mandate Agreements that are signed between the ministry and 45 public colleges and universities, which govern around $4.8 billion per year (about 90% of ongoing operating funding).

dependencies.basis: Tuition policy changes are announced and implemented as part of the broader fiscal and postsecondary sustainability package set out in the Ontario Budget and related ministry announcements.
dependencies.evidence_quote: An updated tuition framework will support the postsecondary sector’s long-term sustainability while maintaining one of the lowest rates of tuition increase in Canada.
